bio: Sociólogo, pesquisador do Centro Nacional de Monitoramento e Alertas de Desastres Naturais (Cemaden) e professor do Programa de Pós-Graduação em Ciência do Sistema Terrestre (PGCST/INPE) e do Programa de Pós-Graduação em Desastres (PGDN/Unesp-Cemaden). Há mais de 15 anos dedica-se à sociologia dos desastres, estudando os impactos dos desastres socioambientais na população e métodos multidisciplinares de pesquisa.
formacao: Pós-doutorado como pesquisador visitante no Natural Hazards Center, University of Colorado Boulder (2022–2023), com bolsa FAPESP
atuacao: Professor do PGCST/INPE e do PGDN/Unesp
Membro da diretoria executiva do RC39 – Sociologia dos Desastres, International Sociological Association (2018–2023)
premios: Pelto International Award 2025, Society for Applied Anthropology (EUA)
livros: Understanding and Addressing Disaster Risk (Routledge, 2025) — coautoria com Ben Wisner, JC Gaillard e Ilan Kelman
Reduction of vulnerability to disasters: from knowledge to action (2017) — coorganização, acesso aberto
bio_en: Sociologist, researcher at the Brazilian National Center for Monitoring and Early Warning of Natural Disasters (Cemaden), and professor in the Graduate Program in Earth System Science (PGCST/INPE) and the Graduate Program in Disaster Science (PGDN/Unesp-Cemaden). For over 15 years he has worked on the sociology of disasters, studying the impacts of socio-environmental disasters on people and multidisciplinary research methods.
formacao_en: Postdoctoral visiting scholar at the Natural Hazards Center, University of Colorado Boulder (2022–2023), funded by FAPESP
atuacao_en: Executive board member of RC39 – Sociology of Disasters, International Sociological Association (2018–2023)
premios_en: 2025 Pelto International Award, Society for Applied Anthropology (USA)
livros_en: Understanding and Addressing Disaster Risk (Routledge, 2025) — co-authored with Ben Wisner, JC Gaillard and Ilan Kelman
Reduction of vulnerability to disasters: from knowledge to action (2017) — co-editor, open access
